desc.zh: 粮册与实仓对不上时，先查账再动粮。
desc.en: When the ledger and the granary disagree, count before you move grain.

desc.en: By winter's end the court must say whether this grain arrangement survives to the next one.

desc.zh: 宗室俸禄、亲兵冬衣与民户口粮争同一批粮。王府账房说仓底只够一半人过冬。
desc.en: Stipends, winter uniforms and household grain draw on one stock; the household office says the granary covers barely half.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1000_cap_stipend = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1001 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 按固定额度发放宗室俸禄，余额留作粮仓与亲兵冬衣。
cost_note.en: Pay stipends at a fixed ceiling and keep the balance for the granary and the guard.

consequence_note.zh: 宗室不满，但粮仓第一次有结余可查。
consequence_note.en: The clan grumbles, but the granary shows a real surplus for the first time.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1000_local_share = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1001 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 把过冬粮的分摊写进地方册，地方按亩摊派并自负运输。
cost_note.en: Write the winter quota into district registers; districts levy it and carry the transport.

consequence_note.zh: 地方财政压力上升，中央仓底压力下降。
consequence_note.en: District finances tighten while the central granary breathes.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1000_grain_loan = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1001 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 向有真实盟约的伙伴借粮，以未来税入作抵。
cost_note.en: Borrow against future revenue from a partner that actually holds a pact.

consequence_note.zh: 欠下一笔要还的粮债；伙伴关系变成账目关系。
consequence_note.en: A grain debt must be repaid, and the partnership becomes an account.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。
cost_note.en: No new cost; this month's window is lost.

consequence_note.zh: 局势不变，下一轮仍可处理。
consequence_note.en: Nothing changes; the offer returns later.

cost_note.zh: 已付的费用与已签的约定不退还。
cost_note.en: Fees already paid and terms already signed are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 这条线记为受挫，名额释放；旧账仍然有效。
consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

purpose.zh: 把过冬变成一次可查的分摊，而不是一次施舍。
purpose.en: Turn surviving the winter into an auditable apportionment rather than a favour.

desc.zh: 俸额一压低，宗室就要求把「例外」写回来。内廷想知道这次封顶是不是只针对旁人。
desc.en: Once the ceiling is set, the clan demands its exceptions in writing, and the inner court asks whether the cap applies to anyone but them.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1001_cap_household = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1002 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 宗室与旁支同按新额领取，不给例外。
cost_note.en: The clan and its branches draw the new rate with no exceptions.

consequence_note.zh: 合法性短期受损，但分摊从此有统一口径。
consequence_note.en: Legitimacy suffers briefly, but the apportionment gains one standard.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1001_cap_exempt_clan = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1002 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 宗室按旧额，缺口由民户额补。
cost_note.en: Keep the clan at the old rate and close the gap from the household quota.

consequence_note.zh: 民户负担上升，地方怨言累积。
consequence_note.en: Household burdens rise and district complaints accumulate.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。
cost_note.en: No new cost; this month's window is lost.

consequence_note.zh: 局势不变，下一轮仍可处理。
consequence_note.en: Nothing changes; the offer returns later.

cost_note.zh: 已付的费用与已签的约定不退还。
cost_note.en: Fees already paid and terms already signed are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 这条线记为受挫，名额释放；旧账仍然有效。
consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

purpose.zh: 封顶的真正内容是「谁也被算进去」。
purpose.en: What a ceiling really settles is who else counts as covered.

title.en: The Registers the Districts Sent Up

desc.zh: 地方粮册的数目与实仓差了两成。是按册发粮，还是先派人下县核仓？
desc.en: District registers overstate the granary by a fifth. Pay by the book, or send clerks to count?

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1002_audit_districts = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1003 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 派官署人员下县核仓，延缓发粮一个月。
cost_note.en: Send office clerks to count, delaying distribution a month.

consequence_note.zh: 账目变实，地方官与粮商都不高兴。
consequence_note.en: The books become true; officials and grain merchants both resent it.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1002_pay_by_register = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1003 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 发得快，缺口留到下一次盘点。
consequence_note.en: Distribution is fast and the shortfall waits for the next count.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。
cost_note.en: No new cost; this month's window is lost.

consequence_note.zh: 局势不变，下一轮仍可处理。
consequence_note.en: Nothing changes; the offer returns later.

cost_note.zh: 已付的费用与已签的约定不退还。
cost_note.en: Fees already paid and terms already signed are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 这条线记为受挫，名额释放；旧账仍然有效。
consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

purpose.zh: 粮册是地方与朝廷之间唯一可查的凭据。
purpose.en: The register is the only checkable link between district and court.

desc.zh: 亲兵营官说冬衣不够，要么拨布，要么缩编。缩编会让守备变薄。
desc.en: The guard commander needs cloth or fewer men. Fewer men means a thinner watch.

label.en: Trim the Ranks, Keep the Cloth

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1003_cap_soldiers = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1004 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 按实有冬衣定额定编，余员遣散归农。
cost_note.en: Set the muster to the cloth on hand and return the rest to the fields.

consequence_note.zh: 守备变薄，军费与冬衣压力同时下降。
consequence_note.en: The watch thins; both the wage bill and the cloth pressure fall.

label.en: Keep Full Strength and Buy Cloth

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1003_keep_full_guard = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1004 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 从粮仓结余拨出一笔买布。
cost_note.en: Draw on the granary surplus to buy cloth.

consequence_note.zh: 守备完整，粮仓结余被吃掉一部分。
consequence_note.en: The watch stays whole; part of the surplus is eaten.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。
cost_note.en: No new cost; this month's window is lost.

consequence_note.zh: 局势不变，下一轮仍可处理。
consequence_note.en: Nothing changes; the offer returns later.

cost_note.zh: 已付的费用与已签的约定不退还。
cost_note.en: Fees already paid and terms already signed are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 这条线记为受挫，名额释放；旧账仍然有效。
consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

purpose.zh: 亲兵是朝廷最后的凭据，也是最先要钱的一笔。
purpose.en: The guard is the court's last warrant and its first expense.

title.en: Grain Prices and the Island Market

desc.zh: 岛内粮价高于外港，粮商把粮往外运。是限运、补贴，还是放开？
desc.en: Island grain prices exceed the outer harbour's, and merchants ship grain out. Restrict, subsidise, or open?

label.en: Restrict Exports and Sell at Cost

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1004_cap_market = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1005 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 禁止粮出岛，由官仓按平价售粮。
cost_note.en: Ban grain leaving the island and sell from the official granary at cost.

consequence_note.zh: 粮价稳住，粮商利润受损、走私抬头。
consequence_note.en: Prices steady; merchant margins fall and smuggling rises.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1004_let_market_run = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1005 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 粮价随市波动，税入增加但不稳定。
consequence_note.en: Prices follow the market; revenue rises but never settles.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。
cost_note.en: No new cost; this month's window is lost.

consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

purpose.zh: 粮价是朝廷与民户之间最直接的一次对话。
purpose.en: The grain price is the most direct conversation between court and household.

desc.zh: 伙伴派来的粮船到了，附带条件：按年付息，且要一份可查的税册副本。
desc.en: The partner's grain ships arrive with terms: annual interest and a copy of the tax register.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1005_take_loan_terms = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1006 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1006 } }

cost_note.zh: 按年付息，并交出一份税册副本。
cost_note.en: Pay annual interest and hand over a copy of the register.

consequence_note.zh: 粮荒缓解，但对方从此看得见本岛税基。
consequence_note.en: The shortage eases, and the partner can now see the island's tax base.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1005_refuse_loan_terms = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1006 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1006 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 粮荒延长一月，但税册不外流。
consequence_note.en: The shortage lasts another month; the register stays home.

purpose.zh: 借粮的代价通常写在附加条款里。
purpose.en: The price of borrowed grain is usually written in an annex.

desc.zh: 冬天过了一半，仓底、税册与民户口粮第一次可以对照。
desc.en: Halfway through winter, granary, register and household ration can be compared for the first time.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1006_publish_count = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1007 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1007 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 合法性上升，差额必须解释。
consequence_note.en: Legitimacy rises, and every gap must be explained.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1006_keep_count_quiet = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1007 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1007 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 短期省事，地方猜疑加深。
consequence_note.en: Easier for now; district suspicion deepens.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，错过这个月的处理窗口。

purpose.zh: 清点是唯一能让分摊站得住的动作。
purpose.en: A published count is the only thing that makes the apportionment stand.

desc.zh: 这一年过完了，要决定这套粮政是临时办法还是常例。
desc.en: The year is over. Decide whether this grain arrangement was an emergency or a standing rule.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1007_make_standing_rule = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1008 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1008 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 每年按同额摊派，朝廷失去临时加派的余地。
consequence_note.en: The same quota recurs each year, and the court loses room for emergency levies.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_e1007_keep_emergency = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_pending value = 1008 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_stage value = 1008 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 保留加派空间，但每年都要重谈一次。
consequence_note.en: Room for levies stays open, but every year is renegotiated.

purpose.en: The difference between a rule and an emergency is whether it is renegotiated next year.

desc.zh: 仓底有了一点余粮。是留作来年缓冲，还是卖给外港换现银？
desc.en: A little grain is left. Hold it as next year's buffer, or sell it at the outer harbour?

desc.zh: 皇室封地围住了岛上社群世代采薪与放牧的坡地。封地文书说这是御苑，社群说这是他们的林子。
desc.en: Royal enclosure cuts across slopes where island communities have cut wood and grazed for generations. The deed calls it a garden; they call it their forest.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_hunting_e1010_co_manage = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_hunting_pending value = 1011 } set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_hunting_stage value = 1011 } }

cost_note.zh: 把采薪与放牧的边界写进共同章程，皇室保留狩猎权。
cost_note.en: Write cutting and grazing boundaries into a joint charter; the court keeps hunting rights.

consequence_note.zh: 皇室独占收益下降，社群对抗下降。
consequence_note.en: Exclusive royal revenue falls and community resistance eases.

cost_note.en: Lease the slopes by area to woodcutters and herders for annual dues.

consequence_note.zh: 税入稳定，但租额一涨就要重谈。
consequence_note.en: Revenue steadies, and every increase means renegotiation.

consequence_note.en: Each payment needs ready money, and communities will demand a say in assessing losses.

cost_note.zh: 把主泊位长约给一家，换取其护航与预付租金。
cost_note.en: Lease the main berth to one house for convoy cover and rent paid in advance.

consequence_note.zh: 现银立刻到账，但补给线从此捏在对方手里。
consequence_note.en: Coin arrives at once, and the supply line passes into that house's hands.

cost_note.zh: 对外船一律征高税，只留最小补给窗口。
cost_note.en: Tax foreign hulls heavily and keep only a minimal supply window.

consequence_note.zh: 短期税入上升，长期补给与情报都变差。
consequence_note.en: Revenue rises briefly while supply and intelligence both degrade.

purpose.zh: 长约占的不是码头，是朝廷以后能不能换个伙伴。
purpose.en: A long lease takes not the wharf but the court's freedom to choose another partner.

desc.zh: 港务说泊位按吨位收钱最公平，商人说按船次更省事。收法一改，谁的钱先到就变了。

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 手续简单，长期停泊者占便宜。

purpose.en: The basis of the due decides who pays for the port.

desc.en: The port needs fresh water and a repaired jetty: from customs revenue, or levied on everyone who uses it?

consequence_note.zh: 港务靠朝廷，用港各方无感。
consequence_note.en: The port leans on the court and users feel nothing.

purpose.en: Whoever pays for the works speaks at the port.

desc.en: The convoy promised for the exclusive lease has arrived only on paper; supply hulls still wait. Renegotiate?

purpose.zh: 长约不是一次签字，是每年一次兑现。
purpose.en: A long contract is not one signature but an annual delivery.

desc.zh: 邻岛的港口愿意接货，条件是要朝廷承认其课税权。这是补给出路，也是主权让渡。
desc.en: A neighbouring island's harbour will take the trade if the court recognises its taxing authority: a supply outlet, and a cession of sovereignty.

purpose.en: A supply line can be bought with sovereignty, and the purchase does not reverse.

desc.en: As the freeze closes in, dock work collapses. Keep a paid watch, or dismiss the gangs until spring?

title.en: Settlement: Who Runs the Southern Port

desc.zh: 泊位、引水、护航与续期都谈过了，南港要有一套定下来的管法。
desc.en: Berths, water, convoy and renewal are all settled; the southern port needs one standing arrangement.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；要求路线成立且连续六个月达标。
cost_note.en: No new cost; requires a live route and six continuous months in place.

consequence_note.zh: 泊位公开、课税有据，朝廷保留换伙伴的余地。
consequence_note.en: Berths are published and dues are documented, and the court keeps room to change partners.

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 港务勉强维持，长约条款留到下一轮再谈。
consequence_note.en: The port barely holds and the lease terms wait for the next round.

purpose.en: The settlement says who may call, and on what terms.
